title: When the Silence Falls
author: Zephyrine Winterbourne
blurb: Odile Thornbury, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
